facts.fact: This document is the text of Burundi's Loi n°1/08 of 20 May 2021, which modifies the statistics law of 25 September 2007 on the organisation of the national statistical system and enters into force on the day of its promulgation.
facts.system: Loi n°1/08 du 20/05/2021 portant modification de la loi n°1/17 du 25 septembre 2007 portant Organisation du Système Statistique au Burundi
